title: From Adele to Amy Whitehouse – the UK school where future stars are made
summary: Since opening in 1991, the BRIT School in London has become a powerhouse in producing global stars of the future, counting the likes of Olivia Dean, Amy Winehouse, Adele and Raye among its alumni. But along with nurturing young talent, the school prides itself above all on being free to attend, with most of its funding coming from the state.
